description: 2-in-1 Cable Design (Built-In + Detachable): Fusion includes two integrated cable options: a built-in Type-C to Type-C cable and a detachable Type-A to Type-C cable. This unique design supports both modern and legacy devices without the need for extra cables. 10000mAh Battery Capacity: Powered by a high-density 10000mAh battery that provides enough backup to charge your phone multiple times. Ideal for daily use, travel, or extended outdoor hours. 22.5W PD & QC 3.0 Fast Charging: Supports 22.5W Power Delivery and Quick Charge 3.0 for rapid charging of smartphones, tablets, and other Type-C devices. Designed to deliver faster charging while protecting battery health. Real-Time Battery Display Indicator: Features a digital battery percentage display for accurate, real-time tracking of remaining charge—making it easy to know when it’s time to recharge. Multi-Layered Protection System: Built with advanced safety mechanisms to guard against overheating, overcharging, overcurrent, and short circuits. Ensures safe charging for your connected devices.
